sources.finding: Chat-first strategy creation, visual editor, backtesting, analytics and strategy library.
Strategy node types include entry condition, profit target, stop loss and capital; examples include momentum, mean reversion and long/short.
Caption describes a prompt-driven investing strategy builder; marks the creator's 44th hackathon at Cursor Singapore. Viewed post and first two carousel images.

artDirection: Retain the existing artwork as the reference; rebuild its ivory-paper, red-chat and navy-blue strategy workbench in native Three.js.
chart: Deterministic illustrative simulation; no claimed investment performance.
animation: Prompt dots, signals along rules, active node accents and a chart-sampling magnifier. Uses the existing renderer's pause and visibility lifecycle.
